integrity: The universal claim is analytic. A standalone finite verifier independently checks all selectors for complete bipartite graphs in a finite test range through total order ten; those checks support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is proved only for complete bipartite graphs. It does not classify arbitrary identity-switch families or supply a replacement group structure. An older equivalent selector-level enumeration under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Identity Seidel switches of \(K_{a,b}\): exact selectors and failure of subgroup closure
